rationale: X is at parity with the references: it accurately covers all requested normalization branches, stubs, `Time.new` forwarding, microseconds, cleanup paths, and the nested-block guard. Its transcript inspected the implementation, focused tests, and supporting date/time-zone methods before answering. shortcomings.summary: X incorrectly says the `#to_time` conversion covers `ActiveSupport::TimeWithZone`.
shortcomings.evidence: `travel_to` skips conversion when `is_a?(Time)` is true at activesupport/lib/active_support/testing/time_helpers.rb:167-168, while `TimeWithZone#is_a?` explicitly returns true for `Time` at activesupport/lib/active_support/time_with_zone.rb:509-513. R1 describes this nuance correctly.
